problem: Native Word font resources/declarations lacked semantic and mutation assertions across DOCX, DOC and RTF. The RTF ftruetype spelling was ignored, yielding Nil declarations. Its native run edit then failed because raw transport hex bytes were compared to decoded semantic text, and the edited token consumed a physical carriage return outside its visible text.
changes: Accept native Word ftruetype as an import alias for the existing TrueType declaration; canonical writing continues to emit fttruetype. Duplicate-format checks apply to both spellings and payload presence stays independent of format.

Share document/group encoding-control interpretation between parser and ordinary source-run mapping. Decode lexical byte transport using the semantic run font explicit codepage, charset and scoped document fallback before matching its text span. Existing source-axis and dependent-content guards remain unchanged.

Use the same byte-based intermediate decoding ceiling as the parser rather than counting UTF-8 transport chars as multiple source bytes. Preserve physical leading/trailing CR/LF outside visible text when calculating edit spans.

Add three DOCX font tests, two DOC font tests, one RTF font test and one public facade test, plus four focused alias/charset/budget/line-break regressions. Add sha2 as a DOC test-only dependency for independent legacy block identity checks.

verification_scope.docx: Full/save-subset native packages expose three exact names and six/two face styles, GUID keys, stored payload lengths/SHA-256, and clear sfnt SHA-256 after deobfuscation. Reobfuscation restores exact stored bytes; font-family no-op and package reopen are exact.
verification_scope.subset: Both Aptos clear programs are identical across full/save-subset variants. w:saveSubsetFonts is a global saved preference, separate from absent per-face w:subsetted. No general subsetting or licensing interpretation is inferred.
verification_scope.docx_edits: One Aptos Regular face is replaced with the same clear program under a fresh key; save/reopen validates requested stored bytes and clear hash while all other fonts/body/settings/style members stay exact. Removing Times New Roman collects exactly font3/4/5 and retains other resources. Inverses restore source bytes.
verification_scope.doc: Exact six SttbfFfn names, two SttbTtmbd offsets3630/573197, font indices5/3, false bold/italic and absent subset order, plus DOP embedding flag. Source-bounded Cambria Math/Aptos blocks have exact569567/99845 lengths and recorded hashes. Body editing preserves descriptions and blocks through reopen/inverse; legacy font bytes stay opaque.
verification_scope.rtf: Five paragraphs,91 sparse font definitions, ten empty TrueType fontemb declarations with exact names/indices/theme roles, absent file/data fields, and Cambria Math without fontemb. Canonical writing retains the complete table and text. Native title editing preserves table/symbols and every source byte outside the edited visible span, including physical CRLF, with exact inverse.
verification_scope.facade: Public native RTF Aptos run property and title mutation reopen with unchanged remaining text, font table and empty datastore; source and inverse bytes are exact.
verification_scope.focused: Standard/native font spellings with absent and inline payloads, canonical spelling and duplicate rejection; Windows1252/Greek/CP932 precedence/Cyrillic/DOS437/DOS850/Macintosh decoding; group encoding restoration beside Unicode;10,000-byte high-character decoding budget parity; CRLF/LF/CR text-edge preservation.
verification_scope.verification: Full DOC/DOCX and RTF owner suites, affected Word/RTF operations and eight-format facade suites pass. Clippy, formatting, corpus integrity and CI configuration checks pass. All newly exposed supported behavior defects have permanent regressions.
verification_scope.environment: All139 native files/four import assets and three pre-existing untracked files retain their bytes. No font installation, glyph rendering, legal licensing determination, macro execution, external resolution or fresh Microsoft Word reopen occurred.
